card.statement:
Let $M=V_{E}^k$.
Since $\gr V_{E}^k$ is free over $\C[J\fing^*]$,
we have the isomorphism

\begin{align*}
\eta_{V_{E}^k}: \overline{V_{E}^k}=E\* \C[\fing^*]\isomap \gr \Zhu (V_{E}^k).
\end{align*}

On the other hand,
there is a
$U(\fing)$-bimodule homomorphism

\begin{align}
\begin{split}
E\* U(\fing)&\ra \Zhu (V_{E}^k),\\ v\*x_1\dots x_r&\mapsto
(1\*v)* (x_1t^{-1})* (x_1t^{-1})+ V^k(\fing)\circ V_{E}^k
\end{split}
\end{align}

which respects the filtration.
Here the $U(\fing)$-bimodule structure of $U(\fing)\* E$ is given by

\begin{align*}
x (v\*u)=(xv)\* u+v\* xu,\quad (v\* u)x=v\* (ux),
\end{align*}

and the filtration
of
$U(\fing)\* E$ is given by $\{U_i(\fing)\* E\}$.
Since the induced homomorphism between associated graded spaces
<<ref:eq;weyl>> coincides with $\eta_{V_{E}^k}$,
<<ref:eq;weyl>>
is an isomorphism.
card.label: Example 104
